content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: The term 'Property' shall refer to the residential property located at 123 Main Street, Springfield City, State of Novacore.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_TERM_OF_LEASE
content_blocks.text: The term of this Lease Agreement shall commence on July 1, 2024 and shall continue until June 30, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._RENT
content_blocks.text: The Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, payable on the first day of each calendar month.
